definitions.explanation: the involuntary expulsion of stomach contents through the mouth

examples.japanese: {嘔吐|おうと}が{止|と}まらない。
{吐|は}き{気|け}と{嘔吐|おうと}の{症状|しょうじょう}がある。
examples.english: I have symptoms of nausea and vomiting.

examples.japanese: {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}で{嘔吐|おうと}した。
examples.english: I vomited due to food poisoning.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{嘔|おう} (vomit) + {吐|と} (spit out) - formal/medical term for vomiting.

VERB FORM:
- {嘔吐|おうと}する (to vomit)

COMMON/CASUAL ALTERNATIVES:
- {吐|は}く (to throw up - common)
- {戻|もど}す (to vomit - euphemistic)
- ゲロを{吐|は}く (to puke - very casual/crude)

RELATED SYMPTOMS:
- {吐|は}き{気|け} (nausea)
- {胃|い}もたれ (upset stomach)
- {悪心|おしん} (nausea - medical term)
